document.abstract: This document references 4096×2160 Digital Cinematography Production Image Formats FS/709 — Mapping into a Multi-link 10G-SDI Mode B defined in SMPTE ST 435-2. This document also defines locations within the bit stream for Audio Data, payload ID and other ancillary data in conformance with SMPTE ST 291. The “Basic Stream” as defined in SMPTE ST 292-1 is utilized as the input source streams for the 10G-SDI.
